whyThisCompany: Coinbase was my introduction to the world of blockchain and cryptocurrency. It was an easy way, on a camping trip, to get started. I was talking with some friends while we were camping, and one of them mentioned that he thinks cryptocurrency is going to be part of his retirement fund. I immediately pulled out my phone, set up a Coinbase account, and made my first investment. It's a great platform and has proven a commitment to security that many other cryptocurrency platforms have miserably failed at. Security is a really important thing to me, and one of the reasons why I continue to use Coinbase.
personalConnection: Coinbase is where my cryptocurrency holdings live, and it's been a place where I've talked to a lot of different people. One of my recent successes in the gift-giving department was the year I gave my wife Bitcoin in a Coinbase account. It's still probably her very favorite Christmas present ever.
uniqueValue:
I'm a generalist, not a deep technical expert. And that means I may not be an ideal fit for this on paper, but what I am is excellent at understanding the principles behind any given set of tasks or work, and then using AI to augment my abilities. It's made everything I've done in the last year much better. It has really enabled me to take on much deeper technical roles across my life, from work to hobbies to volunteer work, because of the augmentation. 

I feel like I receive significant benefit from using AI tools. This isn't just asking ChatGPT to help me be better; I've really learned how to turn the existing skills I have or skills I need to learn into opportunities for AI to give me incredible leverage. That would be a huge part of my role here: using the leverage that AI provides to individuals or teams to help them go faster, make better decisions, and get work done in ways that would be impossible without AI as a team member.
